description: 👻 Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.
summary: Ghostty's libghostty is the piece I didn't know I needed: a zero-dependency C/Zig terminal-emulation library you can embed into another app, which means PenguPool's multi-session routing and AgentOn Pocket's remote session driving could lean on a real, standards-compliant parser instead of shelling out to a full emulator per tab. The architecture is the kind of engineering I respect—dedicated read, write, and render threads, SIMD-accelerated parsing, Metal on macOS—so you get Alacritty-class speed without the feature tax, and the native SwiftUI shell means it feels like a Mac app rather than a web view in a window. For someone juggling a dozen agent sessions locally, a terminal that doesn't burn a core on GPU rendering is the difference between a workflow that scales and one that starts stuttering.
